info.name: Review Dashboard
info.description:
Full API collection for the Project Submission & Review Dashboard.

Use with the 'local' environment (baseUrl, studentEmail, studentPassword, mentorEmail, mentorPassword, studentToken, mentorToken).

Run order: Health > Auth > Submissions > Demo data > Resubmission > Mentor. The Mentor folder stores a pending submission id in the collection variable {{pendingId}}, so it needs the demo data first.

Note: the submission rate limit counts every POST /submissions (including failed ones). Raise SUBMISSION_RATE_LIMIT_MAX in apps/api/.env while testing the full collection.

item.name: Resubmission
item.description: Rejected projects can be resubmitted. Needs Login (student) and Login (mentor) first. Uses a fresh repository URL on every run.

request.description: Creates a PENDING submission for a fresh repository (201). Saves its id into {{resubmitId}}.
